message: dependency cycle: ui/src/api, ui/src/composables, ui/src/stores, ui/src/utils
ui/src/api (layer transport) -> ui/src/stores (layer state) (import) points up the layer order
ui/src/utils (layer utils) -> ui/src/api (layer transport) (import+type-import) points up the layer order

ui/src/api -> ui/src/stores (import) is forbidden by `transport-not-on-store`: FRONTEND_ENGINEERING_PRINCIPLES.md: low-level transport should not import a feature store (known: api/client.ts, api/ws.ts)
